scope: physical and final selected linear fixed-frame shutter bounds after normal native AecUpdateConfig return
limitations: Runtime frame/timing, route endpoints, sensor coefficients and overrides are injected explicitly; complete private-context equivalence is not claimed.

FPS choice, variable-frame-rate/HDR policy, gain/DCG bounds and feedback scheduling remain outside scope.
